review_method: implementer self-review plus coordinator inspection of selected native renders
conditions: Four fresh worker agents in two paired rounds; no inherited conversation, model/reasoning overrides or supplied diagnosis. Same user brief and available tool set. The second round added the same bounded stop reminder to both versions. Control dispatched first; order was not randomized. Directory names reveal version roles. Runtime model identity and token counts were not independently observed.
limits: Two small paired rounds cannot estimate population variance. Local raw implementations and logs remain ignored. Three runs have verified receipt bindings; the fourth uses native host images and recorded browser metrics with no reusable receipt. Snapshots and source inventories record these runs, not clean-clone model reproduction, statistical causation or general intelligence. See HOST-PROBES.md.
